input:
name: Recover the blocked v1.0.1 release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      confirmation:
        description: Type PUBLISH v1.0.1 e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab 33119338872 CONTROL <full main SHA>
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # Share the normal release lock. Crates.io publication and GitHub's latest
  # release pointer must never be mutated by two workflows at once.
  group: axocoatl-production-release
  queue: max
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  LC_ALL: C
  TZ: UTC
  SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: '1787866822'
  RELEASE_TAG: v1.0.1
  RELEASE_VERSION: 1.0.1
  RELEASE_COMMIT: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
  SOURCE_RUN_ID: '33119338872'
  SOURCE_RUN_ATTEMPT: '1'
  SOURCE_PRODUCT_JOB_ID: '98681998480'
  SOURCE_DOCS_JOB_ID: '98681998600'
  SOURCE_BROWSER_JOB_ID: '98681998044'
  SOURCE_MARKETING_JOB_ID: '98681998303'
  COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION: demo/one-app/films/compatibility/v1.0.1.json
  COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION_SHA256: aac79affeb5583659128f24057d40d2667f77a821e6c27995b946f26923eae86
  REQUIRED_CONFIRMATION_PREFIX: PUBLISH v1.0.1 e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab 33119338872 CONTROL

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  preflight:
    name: Bind recovery to the exact failed v1.0.1 release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      # GitHub requires write-level contents access to inspect draft releases.
      # This incident-locked job performs no mutation.
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Prove source, failed run, namespace, and retry state
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RECOVERY_CONFIRMATION: ${{ inputs.confirmation }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" = "axocoatl/axocoatl" || {
            echo "This recovery is locked to axocoatl/axocoatl." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = "workflow_dispatch"
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/main" || {
            echo "Dispatch this incident workflow from main, not $GITHUB_REF." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test "$DEFAULT_BRANCH" = "main"
          expected_confirmation="$REQUIRED_CONFIRMATION_PREFIX $GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$RECOVERY_CONFIRMATION" = "$expected_confirmation" || {
            echo "The confirmation must bind the full frozen release and recovery-control SHAs." >&2
            echo "Expected: $expected_confirmation" >&2
            exit 1
          }
          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

          remote_tag=refs/axocoatl-release/recovery-v1.0.1-tag
          git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
            "+refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG:$remote_tag"
          git fetch --no-tags --prune origin \
            "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main"
          test "$(git rev-parse "$remote_tag^{commit}")" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT" || {
            echo "$RELEASE_TAG no longer identifies $RELEASE_COMMIT." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          main_commit="$(git rev-parse 'refs/remotes/origin/main^{commit}')"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$RELEASE_COMMIT" "$main_commit"
          test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$main_commit" || {
            echo "The dispatched recovery control SHA is not exactly current main." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          git cat-file -e "$GITHUB_SHA:$COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION"
          test "$(git show "$GITHUB_SHA:$COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')" \
            = "$COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION_SHA256"

          cli_version="$(awk '
            $0 == "[package]" { package_section = 1; next }
            package_section && /^\[/ { exit }
            package_section && $1 == "version" {
              gsub(/"/, "", $3)
              print $3
              exit
            }
          ' axocoatl-cli/Cargo.toml)"
          test "$cli_version" = "$RELEASE_VERSION"
          test "$RELEASE_TAG" = "v$cli_version"

          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$SOURCE_RUN_ID" > source-run.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg sha "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
            --argjson run_id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID" \
            --argjson attempt "$SOURCE_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            '
              .id == $run_id
              and .run_attempt == $attempt
              and .event == "push"
              and .head_branch == "v1.0.1"
              and .head_sha == $sha
              and .path == ".github/workflows/release.yml"
              and .status == "completed"
              and .conclusion == "failure"
              and .repository.full_name == $repository
            ' source-run.json >/dev/null || {
              echo "Run $SOURCE_RUN_ID is not the exact failed v1.0.1 release run." >&2
              exit 1
            }

          gh api \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$SOURCE_RUN_ID/attempts/$SOURCE_RUN_ATTEMPT/jobs?per_page=100" \
            > source-jobs.json
          jq --exit-status '
            (.jobs | length == 11)
            and ([.jobs[] | select(.conclusion == "success")] | length == 3)
            and ([.jobs[] | select(.conclusion == "failure")] | length == 1)
            and ([.jobs[] | select(.conclusion == "skipped")] | length == 7)
          ' source-jobs.json >/dev/null || {
            echo "The failed run no longer has the exact reviewed job conclusion set." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          require_job() {
            local id=$1 name=$2 conclusion=$3
            jq --exit-status \
              --argjson id "$id" --arg name "$name" --arg conclusion "$conclusion" \
              '[.jobs[] | select(.id == $id and .name == $name and .conclusion == $conclusion)] | length == 1' \
              source-jobs.json >/dev/null || {
                echo "Required source job is missing or differs: $name ($id)." >&2
                exit 1
              }
          }
          require_job "$SOURCE_PRODUCT_JOB_ID" "Product test gate" success
          require_job "$SOURCE_DOCS_JOB_ID" "Release gate — docs site" success
          require_job "$SOURCE_BROWSER_JOB_ID" "Release gate — embedded product browser" success
          require_job "$SOURCE_MARKETING_JOB_ID" "Release gate — marketing site" failure

          jq --exit-status --argjson id "$SOURCE_MARKETING_JOB_ID" '
            [.jobs[] | select(.id == $id)] | length == 1 and
            (.[0].steps | [.[] | select(.conclusion == "failure")] | length == 1) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Exercise installer OS, libc, and checksum failures" and .conclusion == "success")) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Exercise native license packaging and the four-target release set" and .conclusion == "success")) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Install film inspection dependency" and .conclusion == "success")) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Verify the complete recorded film portfolio" and .conclusion == "failure")) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Sync required brand and component assets" and .conclusion == "skipped")) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Validate static pages, links, assets, and copy" and .conclusion == "skipped")) and
            (.[0].steps | any(.name == "Build and validate the deployment payload" and .conclusion == "skipped"))
          ' source-jobs.json >/dev/null || {
            echo "The source marketing job did not fail only at the known film source-binding gate." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          jq --exit-status '
            [.jobs[] |
              select(
                .id == 98685103422
                and .conclusion == "skipped"
                and (.name | startswith("Build and prove "))
              )
            ] | length == 1
          ' source-jobs.json >/dev/null || {
            echo "The source build matrix was not skipped as expected." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          skipped_jobs="
          Prove complete uploaded artifact set
          Create and verify GitHub draft
          Publish and prove crates.io packages
          Reverify and publish GitHub Release
          Deploy marketing after the product release is public
          Deploy docs after the product release is public
          "
          while IFS= read -r job; do
            test -n "$job" || continue
            jq --exit-status --arg name "$job" \
              '[.jobs[] | select(.name == $name and .conclusion == "skipped")] | length == 1' \
              source-jobs.json >/dev/null || {
                echo "Expected skipped source job is missing or ambiguous: $job" >&2
                exit 1
              }
          done <<<"$skipped_jobs"

          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$SOURCE_RUN_ID/artifacts" \
            > source-artifacts.json
          jq --exit-status '.total_count == 0 and (.artifacts | length == 0)' \
            source-artifacts.json >/dev/null || {
              echo "The failed release unexpectedly owns an artifact." >&2
              exit 1
            }

          expected_assets="$({
            for target in \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin
            do
              archive="axocoatl-${RELEASE_TAG}-${target}.tar.gz"
              printf '%s\n%s\n' "$archive" "$archive.sha256"
            done
          } | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
            | jq --slurp 'add' > releases.json
          release_count="$(jq --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)] | length' releases.json)"
          test "$release_count" -le 1
          if [ "$release_count" = 1 ]; then
            jq --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)][0]' releases.json > recovery-release.json
            jq --exit-status \
              --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" '
                .tag_name == $tag
                and .name == $tag
                and .target_commitish == $commit
                and .prerelease == false
                and (.draft == true or .draft == false)
              ' recovery-release.json >/dev/null
            actual_assets="$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' recovery-release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)"
            unexpected_assets="$(comm -23 \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$actual_assets") \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$expected_assets"))"
            test -z "$unexpected_assets" || {
                echo "The retry release contains an unexpected asset." >&2
                printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_assets" >&2
                exit 1
            }
            jq --exit-status 'all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)' \
              recovery-release.json >/dev/null
            if [ "$(jq --raw-output .draft recovery-release.json)" = false ]; then
              test "$(jq '.assets | length' recovery-release.json)" = 8
              release_id="$(jq --raw-output .id recovery-release.json)"
              test "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .id)" = "$release_id"
            fi
          fi

          crates=(
            axocoatl-core axocoatl-token axocoatl-llm axocoatl-config
            axocoatl-memory axocoatl-graph axocoatl-isolation axocoatl-a2a
            axocoatl-llm-openai axocoatl-llm-anthropic axocoatl-llm-ollama
            axocoatl-llm-mistral axocoatl-llm-gemini axocoatl-mcp
            axocoatl-tools axocoatl-coordination axocoatl-actor
            axocoatl-session axocoatl-service axocoatl-daemon
            axocoatl-server axocoatl-cli
          )
          for crate in "${crates[@]}"; do
            response="$(mktemp)"
            status="$(curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
              --user-agent "axocoatl-v1.0.1-recovery-preflight ($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY)" \
              --silent --show-error --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${crate}/${RELEASE_VERSION}")"
            if [ "$crate" = axocoatl-cli ]; then
              case "$status" in
                404) ;;
                200)
                  jq --exit-status --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" \
                    '.version.num == $version and .version.yanked == false' "$response" >/dev/null
                  ;;
                *) echo "Unexpected crates.io status $status for $crate." >&2; exit 1 ;;
              esac
            else
              test "$status" = 404 || {
                echo "Non-CLI crate $crate $RELEASE_VERSION exists; refusing a CLI-only recovery." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            fi
            rm -f "$response"
          done

  marketing-recovery-gate:
    name: Prove compatible films and the complete marketing payload
    needs: preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: recovery-control
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check out frozen v1.0.1 source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - uses: actions/setup-python@e797f83bcb11b83ae66e0230d6156d7c80228e7c # v6.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13.7'
          check-latest: false
      - name: Require both checkouts to have the reviewed identities
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          test -f "recovery-control/$COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION"
          test "$(sha256sum "recovery-control/$COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION" | awk '{print $1}')" \
            = "$COMPATIBILITY_ATTESTATION_SHA256"
      - name: Exercise the frozen installer with the current release-aware harness
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          contract_root="$(mktemp -d)"
          trap 'rm -rf -- "$contract_root"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$contract_root/scripts" "$contract_root/axocoatl-cli"
          cp recovery-control/scripts/test-install.sh "$contract_root/scripts/test-install.sh"
          cp release-source/scripts/install.sh "$contract_root/scripts/install.sh"
          cp release-source/axocoatl-cli/Cargo.toml "$contract_root/axocoatl-cli/Cargo.toml"
          cmp -s recovery-control/scripts/test-install.sh "$contract_root/scripts/test-install.sh"
          cmp -s release-source/scripts/install.sh "$contract_root/scripts/install.sh"
          cmp -s release-source/axocoatl-cli/Cargo.toml "$contract_root/axocoatl-cli/Cargo.toml"
          "$contract_root/scripts/test-install.sh"
      - name: Exercise native license packaging and the four-target release set
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(python3 --version)" = "Python 3.13.7"
          test "$(git -C recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/test-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Install film inspection dependency
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg
      - name: Verify the incident-specific release compatibility attestation
        run: >-
          node recovery-control/demo/one-app/films/verify-film-set.mjs
          --release-compatibility
          recovery-control/demo/one-app/films/compatibility/v1.0.1.json
          --release-root release-source
      - name: Sync required brand and component assets
        working-directory: release-source
        run: |
          chmod +x sites/marketing/scripts/sync-assets.sh
          sites/marketing/scripts/sync-assets.sh
      - name: Validate static pages, links, assets, and copy
        working-directory: release-source
        run: node sites/marketing/scripts/validate.mjs --strict-films
      - name: Build and validate the deployment payload
        working-directory: release-source
        run: |
          node sites/marketing/scripts/build.mjs /tmp/axocoatl-v1.0.1-marketing
          cp scripts/install.sh /tmp/axocoatl-v1.0.1-marketing/install.sh
          sh -n /tmp/axocoatl-v1.0.1-marketing/install.sh
          cmp -s scripts/install.sh /tmp/axocoatl-v1.0.1-marketing/install.sh
          node sites/marketing/scripts/validate.mjs \
            /tmp/axocoatl-v1.0.1-marketing --strict-films

  build:
    name: Rebuild and prove ${{ matrix.target }}
    needs: [preflight, marketing-recovery-gate]
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-22.04
            glibc_max: '2.35'
            macos_min: ''
          - target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-22.04-arm
            glibc_max: '2.35'
            macos_min: ''
          - target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-15-intel
            glibc_max: ''
            macos_min: '11.0'
          - target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-15
            glibc_max: ''
            macos_min: '11.0'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: recovery-control
      - name: Check out immutable v1.0.1 release source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: release-source
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c # stable 2026-08-23
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: actions/setup-python@e797f83bcb11b83ae66e0230d6156d7c80228e7c # v6.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13.7'
          check-latest: false
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          workspaces: release-source -> target
      - name: Require frozen source and build release binary
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.macos_min }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          test "$(git show -s --format=%ct 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH"
          test "$(git -C ../recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test -z "$(git -C ../recovery-control status --porcelain)"
          cargo build --locked --release -p axocoatl-cli --target "${{ matrix.target }}"
      - name: Prove the declared Linux glibc floor
        if: matrix.glibc_max != ''
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          BINARY: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl
          GLIBC_MAX: ${{ matrix.glibc_max }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          max_required="$({
            readelf --version-info "$BINARY" |
              sed -n 's/.*Name: GLIBC_\([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' |
              sort -Vu |
              tail -n 1
          })"
          test -n "$max_required"
          highest="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$max_required" "$GLIBC_MAX" | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          test "$highest" = "$GLIBC_MAX" || {
            echo "$BINARY requires glibc $max_required, above $GLIBC_MAX." >&2
            exit 1
          }
      - name: Prove the declared macOS floor
        if: matrix.macos_min != ''
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          BINARY: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl
          MACOS_MIN: ${{ matrix.macos_min }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          min_os_values=""
          if command -v vtool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            min_os_values="$({ vtool -show-build "$BINARY" 2>/dev/null || true; } |
              awk '$1 == "minos" { print $2 }')"
          fi
          if [ -z "$min_os_values" ]; then
            command -v otool >/dev/null 2>&1
            min_os_values="$(otool -l "$BINARY" | awk '
              $1 == "cmd" { legacy = ($2 == "LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX"); next }
              $1 == "minos" { print $2; next }
              legacy && $1 == "version" { print $2 }
            ')"
          fi
          test -n "$min_os_values"
          normalized_versions="$(printf '%s\n' "$min_os_values" | awk -F. '
            NF == 0 { next }
            NF > 3 { invalid = 1; next }
            {
              for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i !~ /^[0-9]+$/) invalid = 1
              if (!invalid) printf "%d.%d.%d\n", $1, (NF >= 2 ? $2 : 0), (NF >= 3 ? $3 : 0)
            }
            END { if (invalid) exit 1 }
          ' | sort -u)"
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$normalized_versions" | awk 'NF { n++ } END { print n + 0 }')" = 1
          normalized_expected="$(printf '%s\n' "$MACOS_MIN" | awk -F. '
            NF < 1 || NF > 3 { exit 1 }
            { for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i !~ /^[0-9]+$/) exit 1
              printf "%d.%d.%d\n", $1, (NF >= 2 ? $2 : 0), (NF >= 3 ? $3 : 0) }
          ')"
          test "$normalized_versions" = "$normalized_expected"
      - name: Deterministically package and verify archive twice
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(python3 --version)" = "Python 3.13.7"
          control="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh"
          frozen="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source"
          binary="$frozen/target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl"
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/recovery-control" rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C "$frozen" rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$frozen" "$control" package \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" "${{ matrix.target }}" "$binary" dist
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$frozen" "$control" package \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" "${{ matrix.target }}" "$binary" deterministic-dist
          archive="axocoatl-${RELEASE_TAG}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
          cmp -s "dist/$archive" "deterministic-dist/$archive" || {
            echo "The reviewed packager did not reproduce $archive byte-for-byte." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          cmp -s "dist/$archive.sha256" "deterministic-dist/$archive.sha256"
      - name: Prove any prior-attempt platform artifact is byte-identical
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate --slurp \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100" \
            > run-artifacts.json
          jq --arg name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            '[.[].artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' \
            run-artifacts.json > matching-artifacts.json
          count="$(jq 'length' matching-artifacts.json)"
          test "$count" -le 1
          if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
            mkdir prior-artifact
            gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir prior-artifact
            archive="axocoatl-${RELEASE_TAG}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
            test "$(find prior-artifact -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 2
            cmp -s "dist/$archive" "prior-artifact/$archive" || {
              echo "Prior-attempt artifact $ARTIFACT_NAME is not byte-identical." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            cmp -s "dist/$archive.sha256" "prior-artifact/$archive.sha256"
          fi
      - name: Upload proved platform artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: |
            dist/axocoatl-v1.0.1-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz
            dist/axocoatl-v1.0.1-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 7

  prove-artifacts:
    name: Prove the complete rebuilt v1.0.1 artifact set
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: recovery-control
      - name: Check out immutable v1.0.1 release source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: release-source
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Verify checksums, contents, and exact completeness
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" dist \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin
      - name: Prove any prior-attempt verified set is byte-identical
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: verified-recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-v1.0.1
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate --slurp \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100" \
            > run-artifacts.json
          jq --arg name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            '[.[].artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' \
            run-artifacts.json > matching-artifacts.json
          count="$(jq 'length' matching-artifacts.json)"
          test "$count" -le 1
          if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
            mkdir prior-verified
            gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir prior-verified
            test "$(find dist -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
            test "$(find prior-verified -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
            diff -r --no-dereference dist prior-verified >/dev/null || {
              echo "Prior-attempt verified release set is not byte-identical." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          fi
      - name: Upload the verified recovery release set
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-v1.0.1
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 7

  prepare-release:
    name: Create or reprove the exact v1.0.1 draft
    needs: prove-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    outputs:
      release_id: ${{ steps.release.outputs.release_id }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: recovery-control
      - name: Check out immutable v1.0.1 release source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: release-source
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-v1.0.1
          path: dist
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Reverify, create only missing state, and prove every draft byte
        id: release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" dist \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin

          awk -v heading="## [$RELEASE_VERSION]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' release-source/CHANGELOG.md > release-notes.md
          test -s release-notes.md

          remote_tag=refs/axocoatl-release/recovery-v1.0.1-tag
          require_remote_tag() {
            git -C release-source fetch --no-tags --force origin \
              "+refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG:$remote_tag"
            test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
            test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse "$remote_tag^{commit}")" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT" || {
              echo "$RELEASE_TAG moved; refusing to mutate a release." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          }
          require_remote_tag

          expected_assets="$({
            for target in \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin
            do
              archive="axocoatl-${RELEASE_TAG}-${target}.tar.gz"
              printf '%s\n%s\n' "$archive" "$archive.sha256"
            done
          } | LC_ALL=C sort)"

          refresh_releases() {
            gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
              | jq --slurp 'add' > releases.json
          }
          prove_release_frontier() {
            refresh_releases
            jq --exit-status '
              def valid_semver:
                test("^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$");
              def version_core:
                capture("^v(?<major>0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(?<minor>0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(?<patch>0|[1-9][0-9]*)")
                | [.major, .minor, .patch] | map(tonumber);
              all(.[]; (.tag_name | valid_semver))
              and all(.[];
                (.tag_name | version_core) as $v
                | ($v[0] < 1
                  or ($v[0] == 1 and $v[1] == 0 and $v[2] <= 1)))
            ' releases.json >/dev/null || {
              echo "A release has an invalid namespace or is newer than v1.0.1." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" > latest-release.json
            latest_tag="$(jq --raw-output .tag_name latest-release.json)"
            case "$latest_tag" in
              v1.0.0)
                jq --exit-status '
                  .tag_name == "v1.0.0"
                  and .name == "v1.0.0"
                  and .draft == false
                  and .prerelease == false
                ' latest-release.json >/dev/null
                ;;
              v1.0.1)
                jq --exit-status --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" '
                  .tag_name == "v1.0.1"
                  and .name == "v1.0.1"
                  and .target_commitish == $commit
                  and .draft == false
                  and .prerelease == false
                ' latest-release.json >/dev/null
                test "$(jq --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
                  '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag and .draft == false)] | length' \
                  releases.json)" = 1
                test "$(jq --raw-output .id latest-release.json)" = \
                  "$(jq --raw-output --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
                    '.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag and .draft == false) | .id' releases.json)"
                ;;
              *)
                echo "Latest release must be exactly v1.0.0 or the exact public v1.0.1." >&2
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          }

          prove_release_frontier
          release_count="$(jq --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)] | length' releases.json)"
          test "$release_count" -le 1
          if [ "$release_count" = 0 ]; then
            require_remote_tag
            jq -n \
              --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
              --rawfile body release-notes.md \
              '{
                tag_name: $tag,
                target_commitish: $commit,
                name: $tag,
                body: $body,
                draft: true,
                prerelease: false
              }' > create-release.json
            # This is the first remote mutation. Reprove the complete public
            # release frontier immediately before creating only this draft.
            prove_release_frontier
            gh api --method POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases" \
              --input create-release.json > release.json
          else
            jq --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)][0]' releases.json > release.json
          fi

          verify_release_metadata() {
            jq --exit-status \
              --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" '
                .tag_name == $tag
                and .name == $tag
                and .target_commitish == $commit
                and .prerelease == false
                and (.draft == true or .draft == false)
              ' release.json >/dev/null
            jq --join-output '.body // ""' release.json > actual-notes.md
            cmp -s release-notes.md actual-notes.md || {
              echo "The existing release notes differ from the frozen changelog." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            actual_assets="$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)"
            unexpected_assets="$(comm -23 \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$actual_assets") \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$expected_assets"))"
            test -z "$unexpected_assets" || {
              echo "The existing release contains unexpected assets:" >&2
              printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_assets" >&2
              exit 1
            }
            jq --exit-status \
              'all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)' \
              release.json >/dev/null
          }
          verify_release_metadata

          release_id="$(jq --raw-output .id release.json)"
          [[ "$release_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          draft="$(jq --raw-output .draft release.json)"
          if [ "$draft" = false ]; then
            test "$(jq '.assets | length' release.json)" = 8
            test "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .id)" = "$release_id" || {
              echo "The exact release is public but no longer latest; refusing to reorder it." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          fi

          # Reconcile every pre-existing asset before adding any missing one.
          # A partial draft can continue only when every present byte is exact;
          # a mismatch is intentionally unrecoverable without a separate,
          # explicit decision to replace remote state.
          mkdir existing-assets
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            count="$(jq --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' release.json)"
            test "$count" -le 1
            if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
              asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
                '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | .[0].id' release.json)"
              curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
                --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
                --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
                --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                --output "existing-assets/$name" \
                "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
              cmp -s "dist/$name" "existing-assets/$name" || {
                echo "Existing release asset $name differs; refusing to overwrite it." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            elif [ "$draft" = false ]; then
              echo "Published release is missing $name; refusing mutation." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
          done <<<"$expected_assets"

          while IFS= read -r name; do
            count="$(jq --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' release.json)"
            test "$count" -le 1
            if [ "$count" = 0 ]; then
              test "$draft" = true || {
                echo "Published release is missing $name; refusing mutation." >&2
                exit 1
              }
              require_remote_tag
              prove_release_frontier
              gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" > release.json
              verify_release_metadata
              test "$(jq --arg name "$name" \
                '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' release.json)" = 0 || {
                echo "Asset $name changed during reconciliation; rerun to byte-prove it." >&2
                exit 1
              }
              # An unexpected concurrent asset must fail closed, never overwrite.
              upload_status="$(curl --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 300 \
                --silent --show-error \
                --output uploaded-asset.json --write-out '%{http_code}' \
                --request POST \
                --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
                --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
                --header 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' \
                --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                --data-binary "@dist/$name" \
                "https://uploads.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id/assets?name=$name")"
              test "$upload_status" = 201
              jq --exit-status --arg name "$name" '
                .name == $name and .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0
              ' uploaded-asset.json >/dev/null
            fi
          done <<<"$expected_assets"

          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" > release.json
          verify_release_metadata
          test "$(jq '.assets | length' release.json)" = 8
          test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" = "$expected_assets"

          mkdir downloaded
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].id else empty end' \
              release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              --output "downloaded/$name" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
            cmp -s "dist/$name" "downloaded/$name" || {
              echo "Uploaded release asset $name differs from the rebuilt artifact." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" downloaded \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin
          echo "release_id=$release_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  publish-cli:
    name: Publish only the byte-exact axocoatl-cli 1.0.1 crate
    needs: prepare-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: recovery-control
      - name: Check out immutable v1.0.1 release source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: release-source
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c # stable 2026-08-23
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0
      - name: Package, publish only if absent, and prove the registry checksum
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CRATES_IO_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          test "$(git -C ../recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test -n "${CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN:-}" || {
            echo "The CRATES_IO_TOKEN Actions secret is required." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          registry_token=$CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN
          unset CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN
          readonly registry_token

          crates=(
            axocoatl-core axocoatl-token axocoatl-llm axocoatl-config
            axocoatl-memory axocoatl-graph axocoatl-isolation axocoatl-a2a
            axocoatl-llm-openai axocoatl-llm-anthropic axocoatl-llm-ollama
            axocoatl-llm-mistral axocoatl-llm-gemini axocoatl-mcp
            axocoatl-tools axocoatl-coordination axocoatl-actor
            axocoatl-session axocoatl-service axocoatl-daemon
            axocoatl-server axocoatl-cli
          )
          metadata="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1)"
          declared_crates="$(printf '%s\n' "${crates[@]}" | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          publishable_crates="$(jq --raw-output \
            '[.packages[] | select(.source == null and .publish == null) | .name] | sort | .[]' \
            <<<"$metadata")"
          test "$declared_crates" = "$publishable_crates" || {
            echo "The publish list is not the exact workspace package set." >&2
            diff -u \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$publishable_crates") \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$declared_crates") >&2 || true
            exit 1
          }

          release_crates=()
          for crate in "${crates[@]}"; do
            package_version="$(jq --raw-output --arg name "$crate" \
              '[.packages[] | select(.name == $name) | .version] | if length == 1 then .[0] else "" end' \
              <<<"$metadata")"
            if [ "$package_version" = "$RELEASE_VERSION" ]; then
              release_crates+=("$crate")
            fi
          done
          test "${#release_crates[@]}" = 1
          test "${release_crates[0]}" = axocoatl-cli

          workspace_version="$(awk '
            $0 == "[workspace.package]" { workspace_package = 1; next }
            workspace_package && /^\[/ { exit }
            workspace_package && $1 == "version" {
              gsub(/"/, "", $3)
              print $3
              exit
            }
          ' Cargo.toml)"
          test "$workspace_version" = 1.0.0

          previous_tag_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/recovery-v1.0.0-tag
          git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
            "+refs/tags/v1.0.0:$previous_tag_ref"
          test "$(git rev-parse "$previous_tag_ref^{commit}")" \
            = f9214961efd0408b7fc312f19c6ea8a907cb3303
          non_cli_changes="$(git diff --name-only \
            "$previous_tag_ref^{commit}" "$RELEASE_COMMIT^{commit}" -- \
            Cargo.toml axocoatl-server crates packages)"
          unexpected_non_cli_changes="$(printf '%s\n' "$non_cli_changes" | sed \
            '/^axocoatl-server\/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES\.txt$/d; /^$/d')"
          test -z "$unexpected_non_cli_changes" || {
            echo "The CLI-only release contains unpublished non-CLI package changes." >&2
            printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_non_cli_changes" >&2
            exit 1
          }

          cargo package --locked -p axocoatl-cli
          archive="target/package/axocoatl-cli-${RELEASE_VERSION}.crate"
          test -f "$archive"
          sha256sum "$archive" > crate-checksums.sha256
          test "$(wc -l < crate-checksums.sha256 | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1
          expected_checksum="$(awk '{print $1}' crate-checksums.sha256)"
          [[ "$expected_checksum" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]

          packaged_manifest="$(mktemp -d)"
          tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$packaged_manifest"
          packaged_prefix="$packaged_manifest/axocoatl-cli-${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          test -f "$packaged_prefix/Cargo.toml"
          test "$(awk '
            $0 == "[package]" { package_section = 1; next }
            package_section && /^\[/ { exit }
            package_section && $1 == "version" {
              gsub(/"/, "", $3); print $3; exit
            }
          ' "$packaged_prefix/Cargo.toml")" = "$RELEASE_VERSION"

          remote_tag=refs/axocoatl-release/recovery-v1.0.1-tag
          require_remote_tag() {
            git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
              "+refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG:$remote_tag"
            test "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
            test "$(git rev-parse "$remote_tag^{commit}")" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT" || {
              echo "$RELEASE_TAG moved; refusing an irreversible crate upload." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          }
          fetch_crate() {
            local crate=$1 response=$2
            curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
              --user-agent "axocoatl-v1.0.1-recovery ($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY)" \
              --silent --show-error --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${crate}/${RELEASE_VERSION}"
          }
          verify_cli() {
            local response=$1
            jq --exit-status \
              --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" --arg checksum "$expected_checksum" '
                .version.num == $version
                and .version.checksum == $checksum
                and .version.yanked == false
              ' "$response" >/dev/null || {
                echo "axocoatl-cli differs from the reviewed package or is yanked." >&2
                exit 1
              }
          }

          # Prove the complete 1.0.1 namespace before the only upload.
          cli_response="$(mktemp)"
          for crate in "${crates[@]}"; do
            response="$(mktemp)"
            status="$(fetch_crate "$crate" "$response")"
            if [ "$crate" = axocoatl-cli ]; then
              case "$status" in
                200) verify_cli "$response" ;;
                404) ;;
                *) echo "Unexpected crates.io status $status for $crate." >&2; exit 1 ;;
              esac
              cp "$response" "$cli_response"
              cli_status=$status
            else
              test "$status" = 404 || {
                echo "Non-CLI crate $crate $RELEASE_VERSION exists." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            fi
            rm -f "$response"
          done

          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN="$registry_token" \
            ../recovery-control/scripts/publish-crate-resilient.sh \
              axocoatl-cli \
              "$RELEASE_VERSION" \
              "$archive" \
              "$expected_checksum" \
              "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              "$RELEASE_COMMIT"

          test "$(sha256sum "$archive" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected_checksum"
          require_remote_tag
          cli_status="$(fetch_crate axocoatl-cli "$cli_response")"
          test "$cli_status" = 200
          verify_cli "$cli_response"
          rm -f "$cli_response"
      - name: Prove any prior-attempt CLI checksum artifact is byte-identical
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: recovered-cli-checksum-${{ github.run_id }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate --slurp \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100" \
            > run-artifacts.json
          jq --arg name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            '[.[].artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' \
            run-artifacts.json > matching-artifacts.json
          count="$(jq 'length' matching-artifacts.json)"
          test "$count" -le 1
          if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
            mkdir prior-cli-checksum
            gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir prior-cli-checksum
            test "$(find prior-cli-checksum -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1
            cmp -s release-source/crate-checksums.sha256 \
              prior-cli-checksum/crate-checksums.sha256 || {
              echo "Prior-attempt CLI checksum proof is not byte-identical." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          fi
      - name: Preserve the exact CLI registry checksum proof
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: recovered-cli-checksum-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: release-source/crate-checksums.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 7

  publish-release:
    name: Reprove and publish only the exact v1.0.1 GitHub Release
    needs: [prepare-release, publish-cli]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: recovery-control
      - name: Check out immutable v1.0.1 release source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: release-source
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-v1.0.1
          path: dist
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: recovered-cli-checksum-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: recovery-state
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Repeat every source, artifact, registry, and release proof
        env:
          EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID: ${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.release_id }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          [[ "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          manifest=recovery-state/crate-checksums.sha256
          test -f "$manifest"
          test "$(wc -l < "$manifest" | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 1
          expected_checksum="$(awk '$2 == "target/package/axocoatl-cli-1.0.1.crate" { print $1 }' "$manifest")"
          [[ "$expected_checksum" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]

          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" dist \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin
          awk -v heading="## [$RELEASE_VERSION]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' release-source/CHANGELOG.md > release-notes.md

          remote_tag=refs/axocoatl-release/recovery-v1.0.1-tag
          require_remote_tag() {
            git -C release-source fetch --no-tags --force origin \
              "+refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG:$remote_tag"
            test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse "$remote_tag^{commit}")" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT" || {
              echo "$RELEASE_TAG moved; refusing to publish the GitHub Release." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          }
          prove_release_frontier() {
            gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
              | jq --slurp 'add' > frontier-releases.json
            jq --exit-status '
              def valid_semver:
                test("^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$");
              def version_core:
                capture("^v(?<major>0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(?<minor>0|[1-9][0-9]*)\\.(?<patch>0|[1-9][0-9]*)")
                | [.major, .minor, .patch] | map(tonumber);
              all(.[]; (.tag_name | valid_semver))
              and all(.[];
                (.tag_name | version_core) as $v
                | ($v[0] < 1
                  or ($v[0] == 1 and $v[1] == 0 and $v[2] <= 1)))
            ' frontier-releases.json >/dev/null || {
              echo "A release has an invalid namespace or is newer than v1.0.1." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" > latest-release.json
            latest_tag="$(jq --raw-output .tag_name latest-release.json)"
            case "$latest_tag" in
              v1.0.0)
                jq --exit-status '
                  .tag_name == "v1.0.0"
                  and .name == "v1.0.0"
                  and .draft == false
                  and .prerelease == false
                ' latest-release.json >/dev/null
                ;;
              v1.0.1)
                jq --exit-status --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
                  --argjson release_id "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" '
                    .id == $release_id
                    and .tag_name == "v1.0.1"
                    and .name == "v1.0.1"
                    and .target_commitish == $commit
                    and .draft == false
                    and .prerelease == false
                  ' latest-release.json >/dev/null
                ;;
              *)
                echo "Latest release must be exactly v1.0.0 or the exact public v1.0.1." >&2
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
          }
          require_remote_tag

          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" > release.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
            --argjson release_id "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" '
              .id == $release_id
              and .tag_name == $tag
              and .name == $tag
              and .target_commitish == $commit
              and .prerelease == false
              and (.draft == true or .draft == false)
            ' release.json >/dev/null
          jq --join-output '.body // ""' release.json > actual-notes.md
          cmp -s release-notes.md actual-notes.md

          expected_assets="$({
            for target in \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin
            do
              archive="axocoatl-${RELEASE_TAG}-${target}.tar.gz"
              printf '%s\n%s\n' "$archive" "$archive.sha256"
            done
          } | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" = "$expected_assets"
          jq --exit-status \
            '.assets | length == 8 and all(.[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)' \
            release.json >/dev/null

          mkdir release-assets
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].id else empty end' \
              release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              --output "release-assets/$name" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
            cmp -s "dist/$name" "release-assets/$name" || {
              echo "Release asset $name differs from this run's proved artifact." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" release-assets \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin

          crates=(
            axocoatl-core axocoatl-token axocoatl-llm axocoatl-config
            axocoatl-memory axocoatl-graph axocoatl-isolation axocoatl-a2a
            axocoatl-llm-openai axocoatl-llm-anthropic axocoatl-llm-ollama
            axocoatl-llm-mistral axocoatl-llm-gemini axocoatl-mcp
            axocoatl-tools axocoatl-coordination axocoatl-actor
            axocoatl-session axocoatl-service axocoatl-daemon
            axocoatl-server axocoatl-cli
          )
          for crate in "${crates[@]}"; do
            response="$(mktemp)"
            status="$(curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
              --user-agent "axocoatl-v1.0.1-release-proof ($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY)" \
              --silent --show-error --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${crate}/${RELEASE_VERSION}")"
            if [ "$crate" = axocoatl-cli ]; then
              test "$status" = 200
              jq --exit-status \
                --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" --arg checksum "$expected_checksum" '
                  .version.num == $version
                  and .version.checksum == $checksum
                  and .version.yanked == false
                ' "$response" >/dev/null
            else
              test "$status" = 404 || {
                echo "Non-CLI crate $crate $RELEASE_VERSION exists." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            fi
            rm -f "$response"
          done

          printf '%s\n' axocoatl-cli > release-crates.txt
          recovery-control/scripts/prove-release-crates.sh \
            "$RELEASE_VERSION" release-crates.txt "$manifest"

          draft="$(jq --raw-output .draft release.json)"
          if [ "$draft" = true ]; then
            # This is the only mutation in this job. Refuse to publish or move
            # latest until the exact remote release bytes are reconciled after
            # all long registry checks and the public frontier is re-established.
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" \
              > before-publish-release.json
            jq --exit-status \
              --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
              --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
              --argjson release_id "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" '
                .id == $release_id
                and .tag_name == $tag
                and .name == $tag
                and .target_commitish == $commit
                and .draft == true
                and .prerelease == false
                and (.assets | length == 8)
                and all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)
              ' before-publish-release.json >/dev/null
            jq --join-output '.body // ""' before-publish-release.json \
              > before-publish-notes.md
            cmp -s release-notes.md before-publish-notes.md
            test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' before-publish-release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" \
              = "$expected_assets"

            mkdir before-publish-assets
            while IFS= read -r name; do
              asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
                '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].id else empty end' \
                before-publish-release.json)"
              curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
                --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
                --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
                --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                --output "before-publish-assets/$name" \
                "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
              cmp -s "dist/$name" "before-publish-assets/$name" || {
                echo "Release asset $name changed after review; refusing to publish." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            done <<<"$expected_assets"
            AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
              recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
              "$RELEASE_TAG" before-publish-assets \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin

            prove_release_frontier
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" \
              > before-publish-recheck.json
            for file in before-publish-release.json before-publish-recheck.json; do
              jq --sort-keys '{
                id, tag_name, name, target_commitish, body, draft, prerelease,
                assets: ([.assets[] | {id, name, size, state}] | sort_by(.name))
              }' "$file" > "$file.state"
            done
            cmp -s before-publish-release.json.state before-publish-recheck.json.state || {
              echo "Release metadata or asset identity changed during the final guard." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            # Tag identity is the final read before the exact-ID mutation.
            require_remote_tag
            # Mutate only the reviewed release ID and publication fields.
            gh api --method PATCH \
              "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" \
              -F draft=false \
              -F prerelease=false \
              -f make_latest=true > published-release.json
            test "$(jq --raw-output .id published-release.json)" = "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID"
          elif [ "$draft" = false ]; then
            test "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .id)" = "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" || {
              echo "The exact release is public but no longer latest; refusing to reorder it." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          else
            echo "Invalid draft state for release $EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          public_status=""
          for attempt in {1..12}; do
            public_status="$(curl --retry 2 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
              --silent --show-error --output public-release.json --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
              --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              --user-agent 'axocoatl-v1.0.1-public-proof' \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$RELEASE_TAG")"
            if [ "$public_status" = 200 ]; then break; fi
            if [ "$public_status" = 404 ] && [ "$attempt" -lt 12 ]; then sleep 5; continue; fi
            break
          done
          test "$public_status" = 200
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
            --argjson release_id "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" '
              .id == $release_id
              and .tag_name == $tag
              and .name == $tag
              and .target_commitish == $commit
              and .draft == false
              and .prerelease == false
              and (.assets | length == 8)
              and all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)
            ' public-release.json >/dev/null
          jq --join-output '.body // ""' public-release.json > public-release-notes.md
          cmp -s release-notes.md public-release-notes.md
          test "$(curl --fail --silent --show-error \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
            "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" | jq --raw-output .id)" \
            = "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID"

  deploy-marketing:
    name: Deploy the frozen compatible v1.0.1 marketing site
    needs: [prepare-release, publish-release]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    concurrency:
      group: axocoatl-production-marketing
      queue: max
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: recovery-control
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check out frozen v1.0.1 source

  prove-production:
    name: Prove the public crate, release assets, marketing, and docs
    needs: [prepare-release, deploy-marketing, deploy-docs]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out reviewed recovery control
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: recovery-control
      - name: Check out immutable v1.0.1 release source
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: e82902bdfabb0541e466d5f98f0013cea36bdeab
          fetch-depth: 0
          path: release-source
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-recovery-${{ github.run_id }}-v1.0.1
          path: dist
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: recovered-cli-checksum-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: recovery-state
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Prove the immutable source and every public release surface
        env:
          EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID: ${{ needs.prepare-release.outputs.release_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C recovery-control rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"
          [[ "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          remote_tag=refs/axocoatl-release/recovery-v1.0.1-tag
          git -C release-source fetch --no-tags --force origin \
            "+refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG:$remote_tag"
          test "$(git -C release-source rev-parse "$remote_tag^{commit}")" = "$RELEASE_COMMIT"

          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" dist \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin
          curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 6 --retry-all-errors \
            --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
            "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$RELEASE_TAG" \
            > public-release.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --arg commit "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
            --argjson release_id "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID" '
              .id == $release_id
              and .tag_name == $tag
              and .name == $tag
              and .target_commitish == $commit
              and .draft == false
              and .prerelease == false
              and (.assets | length == 8)
              and all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)
            ' public-release.json >/dev/null
          awk -v heading="## [$RELEASE_VERSION]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' release-source/CHANGELOG.md > expected-public-release-notes.md
          jq --join-output '.body // ""' public-release.json > actual-public-release-notes.md
          cmp -s expected-public-release-notes.md actual-public-release-notes.md
          test "$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --retry 6 --retry-all-errors \
            --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
            --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
            --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
            "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" | jq --raw-output .id)" \
            = "$EXPECTED_RELEASE_ID"

          expected_assets="$({
            for target in \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin
            do
              archive="axocoatl-${RELEASE_TAG}-${target}.tar.gz"
              printf '%s\n%s\n' "$archive" "$archive.sha256"
            done
          } | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' public-release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" = "$expected_assets"
          mkdir public-assets
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            url="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].browser_download_url else empty end' \
              public-release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 6 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --output "public-assets/$name" "$url"
            cmp -s "dist/$name" "public-assets/$name" || {
              echo "Public release asset $name differs from this run's proved artifact." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          AXO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            recovery-control/scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" public-assets \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin

          manifest=recovery-state/crate-checksums.sha256
          expected_checksum="$(awk '$2 == "target/package/axocoatl-cli-1.0.1.crate" { print $1 }' "$manifest")"
          [[ "$expected_checksum" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          crates=(
            axocoatl-core axocoatl-token axocoatl-llm axocoatl-config
            axocoatl-memory axocoatl-graph axocoatl-isolation axocoatl-a2a
            axocoatl-llm-openai axocoatl-llm-anthropic axocoatl-llm-ollama
            axocoatl-llm-mistral axocoatl-llm-gemini axocoatl-mcp
            axocoatl-tools axocoatl-coordination axocoatl-actor
            axocoatl-session axocoatl-service axocoatl-daemon
            axocoatl-server axocoatl-cli
          )
          for crate in "${crates[@]}"; do
            response="$(mktemp)"
            status="$(curl --retry 6 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
              --user-agent 'axocoatl-v1.0.1-final-proof' \
              --silent --show-error --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${crate}/${RELEASE_VERSION}")"
            if [ "$crate" = axocoatl-cli ]; then
              test "$status" = 200
              jq --exit-status \
                --arg version "$RELEASE_VERSION" --arg checksum "$expected_checksum" '
                  .version.num == $version
                  and .version.checksum == $checksum
                  and .version.yanked == false
                ' "$response" >/dev/null
            else
              test "$status" = 404 || {
                echo "Non-CLI crate $crate $RELEASE_VERSION exists." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            fi
            rm -f "$response"
          done

          printf '%s\n' axocoatl-cli > release-crates.txt
          recovery-control/scripts/prove-release-crates.sh \
            "$RELEASE_VERSION" release-crates.txt "$manifest"

          production_ready=false
          for attempt in {1..12}; do
            if curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
              "https://axocoatl.ai/?release-proof=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${attempt}" \
              > marketing-home.html \
              && curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
                "https://axocoatl.ai/changelog/?release-proof=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${attempt}" \
                > marketing-changelog.html \
              && curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
                "https://axocoatl.ai/install.sh?release-proof=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${attempt}" \
                > public-install.sh \
              && curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 60 \
                "https://docs.axocoatl.ai/start/onboard/?release-proof=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${attempt}" \
                > docs-onboard.html \
              && grep -Fq 'v1.0.1' marketing-changelog.html \
              && grep -Fq 'current operating-system' docs-onboard.html \
              && cmp -s release-source/sites/marketing/index.html marketing-home.html \
              && cmp -s release-source/scripts/install.sh public-install.sh; then
              production_ready=true
              break
            fi
            sleep 10
          done
          test "$production_ready" = true || {
            echo "Production sites did not converge to the frozen v1.0.1 payload." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          sh -n public-install.sh

            echo "The dispatched recovery workflow commit is not on current main." >&2

            awk '
              $0 == "[workspace.package]" { workspace_package = 1; next }
              workspace_package && /^\[/ { exit }

            --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --arg sha "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
            --argjson run_id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID" \
            --argjson attempt "$SOURCE_RUN_ATTEMPT" \

              and .run_attempt == $attempt

              and .head_branch == "v1.0.0"
              and .head_sha == $sha

              and .status == "completed"
              and .conclusion == "failure"

          Release gate — embedded product browser

          Build and prove aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          Build and prove x86_64-apple-darwin

            --arg digest "$SOURCE_ARTIFACT_DIGEST" \
            --arg sha "$RELEASE_COMMIT" \
            --argjson artifact_id "$SOURCE_ARTIFACT_ID" \
            --argjson run_id "$SOURCE_RUN_ID" \

              and .name == $name
              and .digest == $digest
              and .expired == false
              and .size_in_bytes > 0
              and .workflow_run.id == $run_id
              and .workflow_run.head_sha == $sha
            ' source-artifact.json >/dev/null || {
              echo "Artifact $SOURCE_ARTIFACT_ID is not the exact verified source artifact." >&2
              exit 1

          curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
            --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
            --header "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
            --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
            --output source-artifact.zip \
            "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$SOURCE_ARTIFACT_ID/zip"
          unzip -q source-artifact.zip -d source-set
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" source-set \

            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin

          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$DRAFT_RELEASE_ID" > release.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" \
            --argjson release_id "$DRAFT_RELEASE_ID" \
            '
              .id == $release_id
              and .tag_name == $tag
              and .name == $tag
              and .target_commitish == "main"
              and ((.draft == true and .immutable == false) or .draft == false)
              and .prerelease == false

              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \

          test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" = "$expected_assets"
