            '.assets | length == 8 and all(.[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)' \
            release.json >/dev/null

          mkdir release-set
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].id else empty end' \
              release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --header "Accept: application/octet-stream" \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
              --output "release-set/$name" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
            cmp -s "source-set/$name" "release-set/$name" || {
              echo "Draft asset $name differs from source artifact $SOURCE_ARTIFACT_ID." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$RELEASE_TAG" release-set \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin

          awk -v heading="## [$RELEASE_VERSION]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' CHANGELOG.md > expected-release-notes.md
          jq --join-output '.body // ""' release.json > actual-release-notes.md
          cmp -s expected-release-notes.md actual-release-notes.md || {
            echo "Release $DRAFT_RELEASE_ID notes differ from the frozen changelog." >&2
            exit 1
          }

on:

  group: axocoatl-production-release

  test-gate:
    name: Product test gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

          fetch-depth: 0

        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}

          set -euo pipefail
          test "$DEFAULT_BRANCH" = "main" || {
            echo "The release workflow requires main to be the default branch; got '$DEFAULT_BRANCH'." >&2
            exit 1

            "+refs/heads/$DEFAULT_BRANCH:refs/remotes/origin/$DEFAULT_BRANCH"
          tag_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"
          main_commit="$(git rev-parse "refs/remotes/origin/$DEFAULT_BRANCH^{commit}")"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$tag_commit" "$main_commit" || {
            echo "Tag commit $tag_commit does not belong to $DEFAULT_BRANCH history at $main_commit." >&2
            exit 1
          }
      - name: Require the tag to match the CLI product version exactly
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(awk '
            $0 == "[package]" { package_section = 1; next }
            package_section && /^\[/ { exit }
            package_section && $1 == "version" {
              gsub(/"/, "", $3)
              print $3
              exit
            }

          test -n "$version" || {
            echo "Could not read the product version from axocoatl-cli/Cargo.toml." >&2
            exit 1

            exit 1

        with:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4

      - name: Install the pinned license notice generator

        run: ./scripts/verify-native-gate.sh

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4

            macos_min: '11.0'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@e797f83bcb11b83ae66e0230d6156d7c80228e7c # v6.0.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13.7'
          check-latest: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c # stable 2026-08-23
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
      - name: Build release binary
        env:
          MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.macos_min }}
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p axocoatl-cli --target ${{ matrix.target }}
      - name: Prove the release binary has no verification switch
        run: ./scripts/check-no-live-verify.sh target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl
      - name: Prove the declared Linux glibc floor
        if: matrix.glibc_max != ''
        env:
          BINARY: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl
          GLIBC_MAX: ${{ matrix.glibc_max }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          max_required="$(
            readelf --version-info "$BINARY" |
              sed -n 's/.*Name: GLIBC_\([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/p' |
              sort -Vu |
              tail -n 1
          )"
          test -n "$max_required" || {
            echo "Could not determine the glibc requirement for $BINARY." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          highest="$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$max_required" "$GLIBC_MAX" | sort -V | tail -n 1)"
          test "$highest" = "$GLIBC_MAX" || {
            echo "$BINARY requires glibc $max_required, above the declared $GLIBC_MAX floor." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          echo "$BINARY requires at most glibc $max_required (declared floor: $GLIBC_MAX)."
      - name: Prove the declared macOS floor
        if: matrix.macos_min != ''
        env:
          BINARY: target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl
          MACOS_MIN: ${{ matrix.macos_min }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          min_os_values=""
          if command -v vtool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            min_os_values="$(
              { vtool -show-build "$BINARY" 2>/dev/null || true; } |
                awk '$1 == "minos" { print $2 }'
            )"
          fi
          if [ -z "$min_os_values" ]; then
            command -v otool >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
              echo "Neither vtool nor otool is available to inspect $BINARY." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            min_os_values="$(
              otool -l "$BINARY" |
                awk '
                  $1 == "cmd" {
                    legacy = ($2 == "LC_VERSION_MIN_MACOSX")
                    next
                  }
                  $1 == "minos" { print $2; next }
                  legacy && $1 == "version" { print $2 }
                '
            )"
          fi
          test -n "$min_os_values" || {
            echo "Could not determine the minimum macOS version for $BINARY." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          normalized_versions="$(
            printf '%s\n' "$min_os_values" |
              awk -F. '
                NF == 0 { next }
                NF > 3 { invalid = 1; next }
                {
                  for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) {
                    if ($i !~ /^[0-9]+$/) invalid = 1
                  }
                  if (!invalid) {
                    printf "%d.%d.%d\n", $1, (NF >= 2 ? $2 : 0), (NF >= 3 ? $3 : 0)
                  }
                }
                END { if (invalid) exit 1 }
              ' |
              sort -u
          )" || {
            echo "Could not parse the reported minimum macOS version: $min_os_values" >&2
            exit 1
          }
          version_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$normalized_versions" | awk 'NF { count++ } END { print count + 0 }')"
          test "$version_count" -eq 1 || {
            echo "$BINARY reports inconsistent minimum macOS versions: $min_os_values" >&2
            exit 1
          }
          normalized_expected="$(
            printf '%s\n' "$MACOS_MIN" |
              awk -F. '
                NF < 1 || NF > 3 { exit 1 }
                {
                  for (i = 1; i <= NF; i++) if ($i !~ /^[0-9]+$/) exit 1
                  printf "%d.%d.%d\n", $1, (NF >= 2 ? $2 : 0), (NF >= 3 ? $3 : 0)
                }
              '
          )"
          test "$normalized_versions" = "$normalized_expected" || {
            echo "$BINARY declares macOS $normalized_versions, expected exactly $normalized_expected." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          echo "$BINARY declares macOS $normalized_versions (release floor: $normalized_expected)."
      - name: Deterministically package and verify archive twice
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(python3 --version)" = "Python 3.13.7"
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh package \
            "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            "${{ matrix.target }}" \
            "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl" \
            dist
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh package \
            "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            "${{ matrix.target }}" \
            "target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/axocoatl" \
            deterministic-dist
          archive="axocoatl-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
          cmp -s "dist/$archive" "deterministic-dist/$archive" || {
            echo "The release packager did not reproduce $archive byte-for-byte." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          cmp -s "dist/$archive.sha256" "deterministic-dist/$archive.sha256"
      - name: Prove any prior-attempt platform artifact is byte-identical
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate --slurp \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100" \
            > run-artifacts.json
          jq --arg name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            '[.[].artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' \
            run-artifacts.json > matching-artifacts.json
          count="$(jq 'length' matching-artifacts.json)"
          test "$count" -le 1
          if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
            mkdir prior-artifact
            gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir prior-artifact
            archive="axocoatl-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz"
            test "$(find prior-artifact -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 2
            cmp -s "dist/$archive" "prior-artifact/$archive" || {
              echo "Prior-attempt artifact $ARTIFACT_NAME is not byte-identical." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            cmp -s "dist/$archive.sha256" "prior-artifact/$archive.sha256"
          fi
      - name: Upload proved platform artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: |
            dist/axocoatl-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz
            dist/axocoatl-${{ github.ref_name }}-${{ matrix.target }}.tar.gz.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  prove-artifacts:
    name: Prove complete uploaded artifact set
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: release-${{ github.run_id }}-*
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Verify checksums, contents, and completeness
        run: >-
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set
          "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          dist
          x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          x86_64-apple-darwin
          aarch64-apple-darwin
      - name: Prove any prior-attempt verified set is byte-identical
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: verified-release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate --slurp \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100" \
            > run-artifacts.json
          jq --arg name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            '[.[].artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' \
            run-artifacts.json > matching-artifacts.json
          count="$(jq 'length' matching-artifacts.json)"
          test "$count" -le 1
          if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
            mkdir prior-verified
            gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir prior-verified
            test "$(find dist -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
            test "$(find prior-verified -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
            diff -r --no-dereference dist prior-verified >/dev/null || {
              echo "Prior-attempt verified release set is not byte-identical." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          fi
      - name: Upload verified release set
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: dist/*
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  prepare-release:
    name: Create and verify GitHub draft
    needs: prove-artifacts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: dist
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Reverify downloaded release set
        run: >-
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set
          "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          dist
          x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          x86_64-apple-darwin
          aarch64-apple-darwin
      - name: Extract matching changelog section
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          awk -v heading="## [$version]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' CHANGELOG.md > release-notes.md
          test -s release-notes.md
      - name: Require the remote tag to still identify this release commit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          remote_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/remote-tag
          git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
            "+refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME:$remote_ref"
          expected_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"
          remote_commit="$(git rev-parse "$remote_ref^{commit}")"
          test "$remote_commit" = "$expected_commit" || {
            echo "Remote tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME moved from $expected_commit to $remote_commit; refusing to mutate the release." >&2
            exit 1
          }
      - name: Reprove release order before draft mutation
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - name: Create or reconcile the exact release without overwriting
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"
          remote_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/remote-tag
          require_remote_tag() {
            git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
              "+refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME:$remote_ref"
            remote_commit="$(git rev-parse "$remote_ref^{commit}")"
            test "$remote_commit" = "$expected_commit" || {
              echo "Remote tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME moved from $expected_commit to $remote_commit." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          }
          refresh_releases() {
            gh api --paginate --slurp \
              "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
              | jq 'add // []' > releases.json
          }
          expected_assets="$({
            for target in \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin
            do
              archive="axocoatl-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-${target}.tar.gz"
              printf '%s\n%s\n' "$archive" "$archive.sha256"
            done
          } | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          verify_release_metadata() {
            local expected_draft=$1
            jq --exit-status \
              --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --arg commit "$expected_commit" \
              --argjson expected_draft "$expected_draft" '
                .tag_name == $tag
                and .name == $tag
                and .target_commitish == $commit
                and .draft == $expected_draft
                and .prerelease == false
                and (.assets | type) == "array"
                and all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)
              ' release.json >/dev/null
            jq --join-output '.body // ""' release.json > actual-notes.md
            cmp -s release-notes.md actual-notes.md || {
              echo "Existing release notes differ from the reviewed changelog." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            actual_assets="$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)"
            unexpected_assets="$(comm -23 \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$actual_assets" | sed '/^$/d') \
              <(printf '%s\n' "$expected_assets"))"
            test -z "$unexpected_assets" || {
              echo "Existing release contains unexpected assets:" >&2
              printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_assets" >&2
              exit 1
            }
          }

          refresh_releases
          release_count="$(jq --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)] | length' releases.json)"
          test "$release_count" -le 1
          if [ "$release_count" = 0 ]; then
            require_remote_tag
            ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" >/dev/null
            jq -n \
              --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              --arg commit "$expected_commit" \
              --rawfile body release-notes.md '
                {
                  tag_name: $tag,
                  target_commitish: $commit,
                  name: $tag,
                  body: $body,
                  draft: true,
                  prerelease: false
                }
              ' > create-release.json
            gh api --method POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases" \
              --input create-release.json > release.json
          else
            jq --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
              '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)][0]' releases.json > release.json
          fi
          release_draft="$(jq --raw-output .draft release.json)"
          case "$release_draft" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          verify_release_metadata "$release_draft"
          release_id="$(jq --raw-output .id release.json)"
          [[ "$release_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]

          mkdir existing-assets
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            count="$(jq --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' release.json)"
            test "$count" -le 1
            if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
              asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
                '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)][0].id' release.json)"
              curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
                --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
                --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
                --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
                --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                --output "existing-assets/$name" \
                "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
              cmp -s "dist/$name" "existing-assets/$name" || {
                echo "Existing release asset $name differs; refusing to overwrite it." >&2
                exit 1
              }
            fi
          done <<<"$expected_assets"

          while IFS= read -r name; do
            count="$(jq --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' release.json)"
            if [ "$count" = 0 ]; then
              test "$release_draft" = true || {
                echo "Published release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is missing $name; refusing to mutate it." >&2
                exit 1
              }
              require_remote_tag
              ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" >/dev/null
              gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" > release.json
              verify_release_metadata true
              test "$(jq --arg name "$name" \
                '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' release.json)" = 0 || {
                echo "Asset $name changed during reconciliation; rerun to byte-prove it." >&2
                exit 1
              }
              upload_status="$(curl --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 300 \
                --silent --show-error \
                --output uploaded-asset.json --write-out '%{http_code}' \
                --request POST \
                --header 'Accept: application/vnd.github+json' \
                --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
                --header 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' \
                --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
                --data-binary "@dist/$name" \
                "https://uploads.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id/assets?name=$name")"
              test "$upload_status" = 201
              jq --exit-status --arg name "$name" '
                .name == $name and .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0
              ' uploaded-asset.json >/dev/null
              gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" > release.json
              verify_release_metadata true
            fi
          done <<<"$expected_assets"

          test "$(jq '.assets | length' release.json)" = 8
          test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" \
            = "$expected_assets"
          mkdir uploaded
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)][0].id' release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              --output "uploaded/$name" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
            cmp -s "dist/$name" "uploaded/$name" || {
              echo "Uploaded release asset $name differs from the reviewed artifact." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            uploaded \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin
          if [ "$release_draft" = false ]; then
            test "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .id)" \
              = "$release_id" || {
                echo "Published release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is no longer latest; refusing a stale rerun." >&2
                exit 1
              }
          fi

  publish-crates:
    name: Publish and prove crates.io packages
    needs: prepare-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@4360b52568e2003a75bf9bc1d59f33a8e3fc893c # stable 2026-08-23
        with:
          toolchain: 1.95.0
      - name: Reprove release order before crates.io publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - name: Publish in dependency order
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CRATES_IO_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          test -n "${CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN:-}" || {
            echo "The CRATES_IO_TOKEN Actions secret is required." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          registry_token=$CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN
          unset CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN
          readonly registry_token
          workspace_version="$(awk '
            $0 == "[workspace.package]" { workspace_package = 1; next }
            workspace_package && /^\[/ { exit }
            workspace_package && $1 == "version" {
              gsub(/"/, "", $3)
              print $3
              exit
            }
          ' Cargo.toml)"
          test -n "$workspace_version" || {
            echo "Could not read workspace.package.version from Cargo.toml." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          metadata_file="$(mktemp)"
          package_changes_file="$(mktemp)"
          plan_file="$(mktemp)"
          cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 > "$metadata_file"
          : > "$package_changes_file"
          if [ "$version" != "$workspace_version" ]; then
            # Only the complete public stable GitHub Release frontier may define
            # the package-change baseline. Local, merged, RC, and internal tags
            # are deliberately irrelevant.
            previous_tag="$(./scripts/resolve-previous-public-release.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME")"
            previous_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/previous-public-tag
            git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
              "+refs/tags/$previous_tag:$previous_ref"
            previous_commit="$(git rev-parse "$previous_ref^{commit}")"
            git merge-base --is-ancestor "$previous_commit" "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}" || {
              echo "Prior public release $previous_tag is not an ancestor of $GITHUB_SHA." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            # The aggregate notice ships beside native binaries and must track
            # the current lockfile even when no library crate is republished.
            git diff --name-only \
              "$previous_commit" "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}" -- \
              Cargo.toml axocoatl-server crates packages \
              > "$package_changes_file"
          fi
          ./scripts/release-plan.sh \
            "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            "$workspace_version" \
            "$metadata_file" \
            "$package_changes_file" \
            > "$plan_file"
          mapfile -t release_crates < "$plan_file"
          test "${#release_crates[@]}" -gt 0
          package_args=()
          for c in "${release_crates[@]}"; do
            package_args+=(-p "$c")
          done
          # Stable Cargo verifies the selected release package set against its
          # temporary registry before any irreversible upload.
          python3 scripts/test-exec-supervisor-artifact.py verify-embedded .
          cargo package --locked "${package_args[@]}"
          for c in "${release_crates[@]}"; do
            archive="target/package/${c}-${version}.crate"
            test -f "$archive" || {
              echo "Package preflight did not create $archive." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done
          if printf '%s\n' "${release_crates[@]}" | grep -Fxq axocoatl-isolation; then
            python3 scripts/test-exec-supervisor-artifact.py verify-packages \
              "target/package/axocoatl-exec-${version}.crate" \
              "target/package/axocoatl-isolation-${version}.crate" --source-root .
          fi
          if printf '%s\n' "${release_crates[@]}" | grep -Fxq axocoatl-server; then
            server_archive="target/package/axocoatl-server-${version}.crate"
            server_prefix="axocoatl-server-${version}"
            server_archive_bytes="$(wc -c < "$server_archive" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
            server_archive_ceiling=9500000
            test "$server_archive_bytes" -le "$server_archive_ceiling" || {
              echo "The axocoatl-server crate is $server_archive_bytes bytes, above the reviewed $server_archive_ceiling-byte release ceiling." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            test "$(tar -tzf "$server_archive" | grep -Fxc "$server_prefix/LICENSE")" = 1
            test "$(tar -tzf "$server_archive" | grep -Fxc "$server_prefix/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt")" = 1
            tar -xOf "$server_archive" "$server_prefix/LICENSE" | cmp -s LICENSE -
            tar -xOf "$server_archive" "$server_prefix/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt" |
              cmp -s axocoatl-server/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt -
          fi
          : > crate-checksums.sha256
          for c in "${release_crates[@]}"; do
            sha256sum "target/package/${c}-${version}.crate" >> crate-checksums.sha256
          done
          test "$(wc -l < crate-checksums.sha256 | tr -d '[:space:]')" = "${#release_crates[@]}"
          expected_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"

          fetch_crate() {
            local c=$1 response=$2
            curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
              --user-agent "axocoatl-release-workflow ($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY)" \
              --silent --show-error --output "$response" --write-out '%{http_code}' \
              "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/${c}/${version}"
          }

          reviewed_checksum() {
            local c=$1
            local archive="target/package/${c}-${version}.crate"
            awk -v archive="$archive" '$2 == archive { print $1 }' crate-checksums.sha256
          }

          verify_published_crate() {
            local c=$1 response=$2 local_checksum
            local_checksum="$(reviewed_checksum "$c")"
            test -n "$local_checksum"
            jq --exit-status \
              --arg version "$version" \
              --arg checksum "$local_checksum" \
              '
                .version.num == $version
                and .version.checksum == $checksum
                and .version.yanked == false
              ' "$response" >/dev/null || {
                echo "$c $version differs from the packaged release or is yanked." >&2
                exit 1
              }
          }

          require_remote_tag() {
            local remote_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/remote-tag
            local remote_commit
            git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
              "+refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME:$remote_ref"
            remote_commit="$(git rev-parse "$remote_ref^{commit}")"
            test "$remote_commit" = "$expected_commit" || {
              echo "Remote tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME moved from $expected_commit to $remote_commit; refusing to publish crates." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          }

          # Discover every pre-existing version before the first upload. This
          # prevents a divergent later package from being found only after
          # earlier missing packages have already been published.
          for c in "${release_crates[@]}"; do
            response="$(mktemp)"
            status="$(fetch_crate "$c" "$response")"
            case "$status" in
              200)
                verify_published_crate "$c" "$response"
                ./scripts/prove-crate-index.sh \
                  "$c" "$version" "$(reviewed_checksum "$c")"
                ;;
              404) ;;
              *)
                echo "Unexpected crates.io status $status while checking $c $version." >&2
                exit 1
                ;;
            esac
            rm -f "$response"
          done

          for c in "${release_crates[@]}"; do
            echo "::group::publish $c"
            archive="target/package/${c}-${version}.crate"
            original_checksum="$(reviewed_checksum "$c")"
            # Recheck the public GitHub frontier before every crate. The helper
            # repeats this immediately before each upload retry, revalidates the
            # remote tag, and blocks dependents until the sparse index agrees
            # with the reviewed package archive.
            ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" >/dev/null
            CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN="$registry_token" \
              ./scripts/publish-crate-resilient.sh \
                "$c" \
                "$version" \
                "$archive" \
                "$original_checksum" \
                "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
                "$expected_commit"
            echo "::endgroup::"
          done

          ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" >/dev/null
          require_remote_tag
          for c in "${release_crates[@]}"; do
            response="$(mktemp)"
            status="$(fetch_crate "$c" "$response")"
            test "$status" = "200" || {
              echo "$c $version is not public after publication (HTTP $status)." >&2
              exit 1
            }
            verify_published_crate "$c" "$response"
            rm -f "$response"
          done
          cp "$plan_file" release-crates.txt
          ./scripts/prove-release-crates.sh \
            "$version" release-crates.txt crate-checksums.sha256
      - name: Prove any prior-attempt crate proof is byte-identical
        env:
          ARTIFACT_NAME: published-crates-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          gh api --paginate --slurp \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/artifacts?per_page=100" \
            > run-artifacts.json
          jq --arg name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" \
            '[.[].artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' \
            run-artifacts.json > matching-artifacts.json
          count="$(jq 'length' matching-artifacts.json)"
          test "$count" -le 1
          if [ "$count" = 1 ]; then
            mkdir prior-crate-proof
            gh run download "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
              --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
              --name "$ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir prior-crate-proof
            test "$(find prior-crate-proof -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 2
            test "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \
              \( -name release-crates.txt -o -name crate-checksums.sha256 \) \
              | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 2
            cmp -s release-crates.txt prior-crate-proof/release-crates.txt
            cmp -s crate-checksums.sha256 prior-crate-proof/crate-checksums.sha256 || {
              echo "Prior-attempt crate proof $ARTIFACT_NAME is not byte-identical." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          fi
      - name: Preserve the reviewed crate publication proof
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: published-crates-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: |
            release-crates.txt
            crate-checksums.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 7
          overwrite: true

  release:
    name: Reverify and publish GitHub Release
    needs: [prepare-release, publish-crates]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: verified-release-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: reviewed
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: published-crates-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: crate-state
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
      - name: Inspect release state, download, and reverify assets
        id: release-state
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_json="$(gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --json isDraft,isPrerelease,tagName)"
          test "$(jq --raw-output .tagName <<<"$release_json")" = "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          test "$(jq --raw-output .isPrerelease <<<"$release_json")" = "false"
          draft="$(jq --raw-output .isDraft <<<"$release_json")"
          case "$draft" in true|false) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          echo "draft=$draft" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          mkdir uploaded
          gh release download "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --dir uploaded
          test "$(find reviewed -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
          test "$(find uploaded -type f | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
          diff -r --no-dereference reviewed uploaded >/dev/null || {
            echo "Draft assets differ from this run's immutable verified release set." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            uploaded \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin
      - name: Require the remote tag to still identify this release commit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          remote_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/remote-tag
          git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
            "+refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME:$remote_ref"
          expected_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"
          remote_commit="$(git rev-parse "$remote_ref^{commit}")"
          test "$remote_commit" = "$expected_commit" || {
            echo "Remote tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME moved from $expected_commit to $remote_commit; refusing to publish the GitHub Release." >&2
            exit 1
          }
      - name: Reprove release order immediately before latest mutation
        if: steps.release-state.outputs.draft == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          ./scripts/prove-release-crates.sh \
            "$version" \
            crate-state/release-crates.txt \
            crate-state/crate-checksums.sha256
          ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
      - name: Publish verified release
        if: steps.release-state.outputs.draft == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          expected_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          awk -v heading="## [$version]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' CHANGELOG.md > release-notes.md
          test -s release-notes.md

          # Reconcile the exact remote bytes only after every long registry
          # proof, then prove that neither the release nor its assets changed
          # while the release frontier was refreshed.
          # GitHub's release-by-tag endpoint never returns drafts; find the
          # one draft for this tag in the release list instead.
          gh api --paginate "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
            | jq --slurp --exit-status --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" '
                [add[] | select(.tag_name == $tag and .draft == true)]
                | if length == 1 then .[0] else error("expected exactly one draft for \($tag)") end
              ' > before-publish-release.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --arg commit "$expected_commit" '
              .tag_name == $tag
              and .name == $tag
              and .target_commitish == $commit
              and .draft == true
              and .prerelease == false
              and (.assets | length == 8)
              and all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)
            ' before-publish-release.json >/dev/null
          jq --join-output '.body // ""' before-publish-release.json > before-publish-notes.md
          cmp -s release-notes.md before-publish-notes.md || {
            echo "Draft notes changed after review; refusing to publish." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          expected_assets="$({
            for target in \
              x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
              x86_64-apple-darwin \
              aarch64-apple-darwin
            do
              archive="axocoatl-${GITHUB_REF_NAME}-${target}.tar.gz"
              printf '%s\n%s\n' "$archive" "$archive.sha256"
            done
          } | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          test "$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' before-publish-release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)" \
            = "$expected_assets"
          mkdir before-publish-assets
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].id else empty end' \
              before-publish-release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              --output "before-publish-assets/$name" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
            cmp -s "reviewed/$name" "before-publish-assets/$name" || {
              echo "Draft asset $name changed after review; refusing to publish." >&2
              exit 1
            }
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          ./scripts/release-artifact.sh verify-set \
            "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" before-publish-assets \
            x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu \
            x86_64-apple-darwin \
            aarch64-apple-darwin

          ./scripts/verify-release-order.sh "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          release_id="$(jq --raw-output .id before-publish-release.json)"
          [[ "$release_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" \
            > before-publish-recheck.json
          for file in before-publish-release.json before-publish-recheck.json; do
            jq --sort-keys '{
              id, tag_name, name, target_commitish, body, draft, prerelease,
              assets: ([.assets[] | {id, name, size, state}] | sort_by(.name))
            }' "$file" > "$file.state"
          done
          cmp -s before-publish-release.json.state before-publish-recheck.json.state || {
            echo "Draft metadata or asset identity changed during the final guard." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          remote_ref=refs/axocoatl-release/remote-tag
          git fetch --no-tags --force origin \
            "+refs/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME:$remote_ref"
          test "$(git rev-parse "$remote_ref^{commit}")" = "$expected_commit" || {
            echo "Remote tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME moved; refusing to publish." >&2
            exit 1
          }

          gh api --method PATCH \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" \
            -F draft=false \
            -F prerelease=false \
            -f make_latest=true > published-release.json
          test "$(jq --raw-output .id published-release.json)" = "$release_id"
      - name: Prove the release is public and not a prerelease
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          expected_commit="$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_SHA^{commit}")"
          awk -v heading="## [$version]" '
            /^## \[/ {
              if (found) exit
              if ($0 == heading || index($0, heading " ") == 1) found = 1
            }
            found { print }
            END { if (!found) exit 1 }
          ' CHANGELOG.md > release-notes.md
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$GITHUB_REF_NAME" \
            > public-release.json
          jq --exit-status \
            --arg tag "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --arg commit "$expected_commit" '
              .tag_name == $tag
              and .name == $tag
              and .target_commitish == $commit
              and .draft == false
              and .prerelease == false
              and (.assets | length == 8)
              and all(.assets[]; .state == "uploaded" and .size > 0)
            ' public-release.json >/dev/null
          jq --join-output '.body // ""' public-release.json > public-release-notes.md
          cmp -s release-notes.md public-release-notes.md

          expected_assets="$(jq --raw-output '.assets[].name' public-release.json | LC_ALL=C sort)"
          test "$(printf '%s\n' "$expected_assets" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]')" = 8
          mkdir public-assets
          while IFS= read -r name; do
            asset_id="$(jq --exit-status --raw-output --arg name "$name" \
              '[.assets[] | select(.name == $name)] | if length == 1 then .[0].id else empty end' \
              public-release.json)"
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-all-errors \
              --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 180 \
              --header 'Accept: application/octet-stream' \
              --header "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" \
              --header 'X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28' \
              --output "public-assets/$name" \
              "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/assets/$asset_id"
            cmp -s "reviewed/$name" "public-assets/$name"
          done <<<"$expected_assets"
          diff -r --no-dereference reviewed public-assets >/dev/null
          ./scripts/prove-release-crates.sh \
            "$version" \
            crate-state/release-crates.txt \
            crate-state/crate-checksums.sha256
          release_id="$(jq --raw-output .id public-release.json)"
          latest_id="$(gh api \
            "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .id)"
          test "$latest_id" = "$release_id" || {
            echo "Published release $GITHUB_REF_NAME is not GitHub's latest release." >&2
            exit 1
          }

  deploy-marketing:
    name: Deploy marketing after the product release is public
    needs: [release, marketing-site]
    permissions:
      contents: read
      deployments: write
    uses: ./.github/workflows/marketing-deploy.yml

name: dns-add

# Tries to write the missing CNAMEs for docs + www directly to the
# Cloudflare zone, and reports the token's actual scopes so we know
# whether the API has Zone:DNS:Edit permission.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  add:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          T: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          A: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4"
          H="Authorization: Bearer $T"

          echo "=== Token scopes ==="
          curl -sS "$API/user/tokens/verify" -H "$H" | jq '{success, errors, result: {status: .result.status, policies: .result.policies}}'

          echo
          echo "=== Find zone ==="
          ZR=$(curl -sS "$API/zones?name=axocoatl.ai" -H "$H")
          echo "$ZR" | jq '{success, errors}'
          ZID=$(echo "$ZR" | jq -r '.result[0].id // empty')
          echo "zone id: ${ZID:-<<not visible to this token>>}"

          if [ -z "$ZID" ]; then
            echo
            echo "Token cannot read zones — manual DNS record needed."
            exit 0
          fi

          add_cname() {
            local sub="$1" target="$2"
            local resp
            resp=$(curl -sS -X POST "$API/zones/$ZID/dns_records" \
              -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"type\":\"CNAME\",\"name\":\"$sub\",\"content\":\"$target\",\"proxied\":true,\"ttl\":1}")
            local ok
            ok=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.success')
            if [ "$ok" = "true" ]; then
              echo "  ✓ $sub → $target"
            else
              local msg
              msg=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.errors[0].message // empty')
              # Already-exists errors are fine
              if echo "$msg" | grep -qi "identical\|already\|exists"; then
                echo "  ✓ $sub → $target (already)"
              else
                echo "  ✗ $sub: $msg"
              fi
            fi
          }

          echo
          echo "=== Adding CNAMEs ==="
          add_cname "docs" "axocoatl-docs.pages.dev"
          add_cname "www"  "axocoatl-marketing.pages.dev"

# CLI product version already has a public GitHub release. release.yml calls this
# workflow after publishing that release and requires the deployment to finish.

      - 'docs/**'
      - 'branding/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docs-deploy.yml'

input:
name: setup-cloudflare

# One-shot bootstrap: creates the two Cloudflare Pages projects and
# attaches their custom domains using the existing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
# and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID secrets.  Idempotent — re-running is safe.
#
# Trigger from the Actions tab → "setup-cloudflare" → Run workflow.

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Create Pages projects + custom domains
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4"
          ACCT="$CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID"
          AUTH="Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
          test -n "$ACCT"
          test -n "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"

          api_get() {
            curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 30 \
              --silent --show-error --fail-with-body \
              -H "$AUTH" "$API/$1"
          }

          verify_project() {
            local name="$1"
            local response
            response="$(api_get "accounts/$ACCT/pages/projects/$name")"
            test "$(jq -r '.success' <<<"$response")" = "true"
            test "$(jq -r '.result.name' <<<"$response")" = "$name"
            test "$(jq -r '.result.production_branch' <<<"$response")" = "main" || {
              echo "  ✗ existing project $name does not use production branch main" >&2
              return 1
            }
            echo "  ✓ verified project identity and production branch"
          }

          verify_domain() {
            local project="$1"
            local domain="$2"
            local response status
            for attempt in {1..18}; do
              response="$(api_get "accounts/$ACCT/pages/projects/$project/domains")"
              test "$(jq -r '.success' <<<"$response")" = "true"
              status="$(jq -r --arg domain "$domain" \
                '[.result[] | select(.name == $domain) | .status] | if length == 1 then .[0] else "" end' \
                <<<"$response")"
              if [ "$status" = "active" ]; then
                echo "  ✓ verified active on $project"
                return 0
              fi
              if [ -n "$status" ] && [ "$attempt" -lt 18 ]; then
                echo "  … domain status is $status; waiting for active"
                sleep 10
                continue
              fi
              break
            done
            echo "  ✗ $domain is not uniquely active on $project (status: ${status:-missing})" >&2
            return 1
          }

          create_project() {
            local name="$1"
            echo "── Creating Pages project: $name"
            local response
            response=$(curl -sS -X POST "$API/accounts/$ACCT/pages/projects" \
              -H "$AUTH" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"name\":\"$name\",\"production_branch\":\"main\"}")
            local success
            success=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.success')
            if [ "$success" = "true" ]; then
              echo "  ✓ created"
              echo "$response" | jq -r '.result | "    subdomain: " + .subdomain'
            else
              # Idempotent only after the existing project's identity and
              # production branch are positively verified below.
              local code
              code=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.errors[0].code // empty')
              if [ "$code" != "8000007" ]; then
                echo "  ✗ failed:"
                echo "$response" | jq .
                return 1
              fi
              echo "  ✓ already exists"
            fi
            verify_project "$name"
          }

          add_domain() {
            local project="$1"
            local domain="$2"
            echo "── Attaching custom domain: $domain → $project"
            local response
            response=$(curl -sS -X POST "$API/accounts/$ACCT/pages/projects/$project/domains" \
              -H "$AUTH" \
              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
              -d "{\"name\":\"$domain\"}")
            local success
            success=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.success')
            if [ "$success" = "true" ]; then
              echo "  ✓ attached"
            else
              # An already/duplicate response is acceptable only if the
              # project-specific domain list proves the requested attachment.
              local msg
              msg=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.errors[0].message // empty')
              if ! echo "$msg" | grep -qi "already\|duplicate"; then
                echo "  ✗ failed:"
                echo "$response" | jq .
                return 1
              fi
              echo "  ✓ already attached"
            fi
            verify_domain "$project" "$domain"
          }

          # Step 1 — projects
          create_project axocoatl-marketing
          create_project axocoatl-docs

          # Step 2 — custom domains
          add_domain axocoatl-marketing axocoatl.ai
          add_domain axocoatl-marketing www.axocoatl.ai
          add_domain axocoatl-docs     docs.axocoatl.ai

          echo
          echo "── Done. Now re-run marketing-deploy + docs-deploy."

      - name: Re-fire deploy workflows
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh workflow run marketing-deploy.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref main
          gh workflow run docs-deploy.yml --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --ref main

id: qa

  explorer_model: { kind: model, required: true }
  target_url:     { kind: url, default: http://localhost:3000 }
  reference_url:  { kind: url }   # optional: without it findings are "reproduced", never "confirmed"
agents:
  - id: explorer
    role: explorer
    model: { param: explorer_model }
    tools: [read_file, list_dir, grep, glob, write_file, browser, browser_check]
    writes: ["axocoatl-qa/**"]
    instructions: >-
      ... For every bug, write a Playwright test under axocoatl-qa/ that fails because of
      the bug and confirm it with browser_check. End with a FINDINGS JSON block and a
      COVERAGE JSON block listing every area as covered, not_reached or blocked.
qa:
  target_url: { param: target_url }
  reference_url: { param: reference_url }
  repro_dir: axocoatl-qa   # browser_check reads no path segment starting with "."
  fail_on_findings: true
budgets:
  agent: { activations: 2, invocations: 600, tokens: 6000000, cost_usd: 15 }
  wall_clock: 90m
prompt: |
  Explore the app at {target_url} and report its bugs.
  {task}
sandbox: { network: egress, workload: hardened }
